reference_description: The plot illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers in a model under a baseline condition. The x-axis is labeled "Layer," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 24 with tick labelsat intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" and also uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600 with tick labels at intervals of 200. There are four lines presented in the plot. The blue dashed line, representing "attn_output," starts near zero, remaining relatively flat across the x-axis before increasing sharply to max activation value of 200 between layers 22 and 23. The orange dotted line, representing "attn_residual," starts and stays at 0 at the beginning, peaks sharply at layer 5 to an activation value around 1400, remains relatively stable between 1400 and 1600, and then declines rapidly after layer 22. The green dash-dot line, representing "ffn_output," remains near zero, with large spikes up to approximately 1000 at layers 5, 13, and 22. Lastly, the red solid line labeled "ffn_residual" shows a similar pattern to the dotted orange line which represents "attn_residual."
